req.title: Reject duplicate playerId on create
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 409 Conflict when POST /players/ is called with an ID that already exists.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should reject duplicate player IDs with an HTTP 409 Conflict response. This behavior needs to be validated through tests that cover positive, negative, and boundary cases to ensure robustness against common mutations.

tests.name: test_create_player_success
preconditions: The player with squad number 10 does not exist in the system.
actions: Send a POST request to /players/ with a unique squad number.
expected: The response contains the created player data.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

player_data = {
    "first_name": "Lionel",
    "middle_name": "",
    "last_name": "Messi",
    "date_of_birth": "1987-06-24",
    "squad_number": 10,
    "position": "Forward",
    "abbr_position": "FW",
    "team": "PSG",
    "league": "Ligue 1",
    "starting11": True
}

response = client.post("/players/", json=player_data)
assert response.status_code == 201
assert response.json()["squadNumber"] == 10

tests.name: test_create_player_duplicate
preconditions: A player with squad number 10 already exists in the system.
actions: Send a POST request to /players/ with the same squad number.
expected: The response contains a conflict error message.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

player_data = {
    "first_name": "Lionel",
    "middle_name": "",
    "last_name": "Messi",
    "date_of_birth": "1987-06-24",
    "squad_number": 10,
    "position": "Forward",
    "abbr_position": "FW",
    "team": "PSG",
    "league": "Ligue 1",
    "starting11": True
}

# Create the player first
client.post("/players/", json=player_data)

# Attempt to create the same player again
response = client.post("/players/", json=player_data)
assert response.status_code == 409
assert "A Player with this squad number already exists." in response.json()["detail"]

tests.name: test_create_player_boundary
preconditions: The player with squad number 1 does not exist in the system.
actions: Send a POST request to /players/ with squad number 1.
expected: The response contains the created player data.
